chunks: My father, may Allah grant him mercy, said: We were told by Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Abdullah ibn Maimoun, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father, peace be upon him, that he said:
The Messenger of Allah, Allah’s blessings be upon him and his Family, said: Faith is (consisting of) saying and action, (the like of) two associating brothers.
ai.seo_question: What are the two components of faith according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq, transmitted via the chain of Shaykh al-Saduq, articulates the Shia doctrine of the inseparability of belief and practice, countering sects that viewed Iman as merely verbal. By describing Qawl and Amal as 'two associating brothers,' it underscores that true faith is a unified entity where declaration and deed mutually reinforce each other, a view central to the Ahl al-Bayt's understanding of spiritual integrity.
